title.narrative: Marketing/Storage/Processing: Fostering Climate Resilient Upland Farming Systems in the North East (Mizoram and Nagaland States)

description.narrative: The overall goal of the project are to increase the incomes of 137,000 rural highland farming households in Nagaland and 64,500 households in Mizoram, and enhance their resilience to climate change. This goal will be achieved through the development objective of increasing the environmental sustainability and profitability of farming systems utilized by highland farmers.
